In ancient times, Princess Jiuyou of the Shadow Kingdom, as the leader of the Phantom Clan, created the divine artifact Jiuyou Phantom Flute to protect her homeland. To strengthen the power of her tribe, she gathered the power of the Shadow Kingdom here.

Sa · Nine Tailed Fox Fur Stunt: Two Moves, Preventing Critical Strike, Moving+3.

According to legend, the fox fur bestowed upon Daji by King Zhou was woven from the rare hair left behind on the divine beast Nine Tailed Fox, possessing special energy.

Sa · Enchanted Fragrant Bag Trick: \[Mist] Enemy Chaos, Crossover Movement, and Exhaustion of Daggers within a 3-grid range. Skill cooldown: Available in multiples of 4 rounds. Definitely kill an enemy and absorb their life!（Single damage to Force Shield units is equivalent to shield value）

According to the special effects design of Zhuo Wenjun and his transfer props, Zhuo Wenjun's exclusive costume!

Suit Details

Sa · Lvqi special effects: spell critical strike 130%, 【 God's Disaster 】 spirit+20%, spell damage+50%

Lvqi is a famous qin used by the famous Han Dynasty literati Sima Xiangru (husband of Zhuo Wenjun). After Sima Xiangru obtained Lvqi, he was like a precious treasure. His exquisite piano skills endowed Lvqi with a wonderful sound, making her famous for a while. Green Qi is black all over, with a faint green hue, like green vines winding around ancient trees, hence the name "Green Qi".

Sa Liuli Nishang special skill: restore state every turn, Force Shield 20%, prevent fatal strikes

The Liuli Nishang is not only the most beautiful costume artifact in the immortal realm, but also the ultimate treasure that countless cultivators dream of, endowing the wearer with endless power and elegance, making it dazzling and unparalleled like glass in the immortal realm.

Sa Tianji Mirror Trick: Second Action, all terrain adaptation of 120, spell must hit

The Tianji Mirror, as an important component of the top ten ancient artifacts, is essentially a causal law tool that transcends physical laws. The mirror body is made of Tian Shan Xuan jade and Jiu You Han iron melted and cast, and the surface is engraved with the trajectory of the Zhou Tian Star Dipper. The causal veins of the Three Realms and Six Paths can be observed through mirror reflection.

Set effect: Self life+200, mana+100, self full ability bonus of 22%,+1 movement, full ability bonus of 3% for allies and other units of our army.

notes.title: Xiang Yu&Princess Pingyang Exclusive Customized Equipment DLC Release and Xianda
notes.notes:
Xiang Yu's exclusive custom king outfit attributes:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3835310/DLC/"][/dynamiclink]

Ba · Hu Tou Pan Long Halberd: 20% life attack, 90% solidification of enemy terrain, fighting with 5 people

Legend has it that before Xiang Yu rose up, a meteorite fell from Kuaiji County. Later, Xiang Liang privately invited local famous people who cast weapons to use this stone to take iron for Xiang Yu to forge weapons. After nine days and nine nights, it was finally forged into a giant tiger headed coiled dragon halberd, which was one foot two feet nine inches long and weighed 129 pounds. Xiang Yu named it "Ghost God"!

Ba Wujin Armor: Bloodsucking attack 60%, attack and defend freely 60%, first hand attack

This magical soft armor seems to blend seamlessly with the skin, and its unique craftsmanship allows it to tightly adhere to the body. It cannot be penetrated by knives or guns, nor can it be damaged by water or fire, making it an unparalleled defense weapon in the era of cold weapons.

Ba Wu Da: Traverse and move, automatically restore state every round, second action

The Wushi horse comes from the mount of the tyrant Xiang Yu in the novel "Romance of the Western Han Dynasty". This horse was known as the world's best steed during Xiang Yu's reign. The Wusong is a black horse, with a body that is as black as satin, shining brightly with oil. Only the four hooves are as white as snow. The Wusong has a long back and a short, straight waist, and well-developed joints and tendons in its limbs. This type of horse has a head and is called the "Tuyun Wusong".

Xiang Yu suit effect: Self life+200, mana+100, self full ability bonus of 25%,+2 movement, allied and other units of our army ability bonus of 5%.

notes.title: The Fate War Merit dungeon has undergone a major update
notes.notes:
The Fate War level has been expanded from the previous 11 levels to 21 levels, and will be updated to 30 levels. After updating to 30 levels, the dungeon output and merit exchange content will be further optimized to improve the speed of obtaining Fate War merits. The new levels 12-21 adopt a brand new map design, optimizing the enemy's deployment strategy and special effects of different units, which will change according to the level changes.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3615580/DLC/"][/dynamiclink]
